translation.title: Analgesic and Anti-inflammatory Plaster
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the analgesic and anti-inflammatory relief of osteoarthritis (degenerative arthritis), periarthritis of the shoulder, tendinitis and tenosynovitis, peritendinitis, epicondylitis of the humerus (such as tennis elbow), muscle pain, and swelling and pain after an injury.
translation.usage: Peel off the release liner from the medicated surface and apply the patch to the affected area twice a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine in the following cases: hypersensitivity to this medicine; aspirin-induced asthma, current or past; experience of hypersensitivity to tiaprofenic acid, fenofibrate, bezafibrate, ciprofibrate or oxybenzone; women who are 6 months or more pregnant; children under 15 years of age; the eyes and mucous membranes; athlete’s foot; ringworm. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before using this medicine in the following cases: people with bronchial asthma; pregnant or breastfeeding women. If your symptoms do not improve after about 1 week of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. While using this medicine and for 2 weeks after use, avoid outdoor activity regardless of the weather and cover the application site with coloured clothing, sunglasses, a hat or sunscreen so that it is not exposed to ultraviolet light. White or thin clothing can let ultraviolet light through, so wear coloured clothing. Do not use an occlusive dressing. Stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if any of the following occur: shock (urticaria, difficulty breathing, facial swelling and the like), rarely; dry rales (a bubbling sound); wheezing; difficulty breathing; skin reactions (occasional redness, rash, itching, blisters, erosion, contact dermatitis such as irritation and swelling, dry skin and pigmentation, photosensitivity). Keep out of reach of children.
